title: Exchange compatibility for a strict-local representative map
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, f:X→Y a scheme morphism, s:Spec Ω→Y a geometric point with Ω algebraically closed, and (g′:X′→X,f′:X′→Spec Ω,f,s) a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let F be a Λ-module sheaf on X_et. Use the canonical full affine pointed-neighbourhood colimit presentation S_(s)=strictLocalization(s) of the strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], canonically isomorphic to the small representative ring-colimit presentation, with structural map ρ=strictLocalizationToBase(s) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put Z=X×_Y S_(s), p:Z→X, h:Z→S_(s), and H=p⁻¹F. Suppose t:Spec Ω→S_(s) restricts along each strictHenselizationAffineCone leg and the canonical Spec/Γ identification to its marked point. Suppose q:X′→Z satisfies qh=f′t and qp=g′. Let a:(f_*F)_s→Γ(Z,H) be any module map satisfying IsQcqsStrictLocalModuleComparison Λ f s F a [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-strict-local-module-comparison]: every small affine pointed representative germ followed by a is qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction along that representative's full-model limit leg. Then the identity geometric stalk of baseChangeMap [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] equals upperStarCompSheafFiberIso(s,id).hom, the equality transport from the stalk at id≫s to that at s, a, globalSectionsUpperStarMap(q,H), the global-section map of upperStarComp(q,p,g′,hq.symm).inv, lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso(f′).inv, the global-to-terminal-section identification on Spec Ω, and its identity-neighbourhood germ, in this order. No qcqs, properness, local-ring, closed-point or invertibility assumption is required. Stalks and germs are the actual site-point fibre functors [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]; restriction on global sections is [def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback].

proof.text: Use the existing adopted proof verbatim. Cancel geometricPointSourceStalkIso and apply colimit hom-ext using the initial small affine pointed representatives, with strictHenselizationAffineProperties. On a representative, exchange_pointed_representative computes the left side. strictLocal_section_pullback identifies restriction of the full-model limit leg along q with geometricFibreSectionRestriction and inverse terminal evaluation, using hpoint, hqt and hq. Postcompose by the pushforward/global-section comparison and terminal germ, substitute the germ equation ha, and reassociate. This is the full-presentation version of the same compatibility identity; no properness or comparison invertibility is used.

theorem strictLocal_exchange_compatibility
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Scheme.strictLocalization s)
    (hpoint : ∀ j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      t ≫ (Scheme.strictHenselizationAffineCone s).π.app (op (op j)) ≫
        (Spec (unop ((equivSmallModel.{u}
          (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1.left)).isoSpec.inv =
        ((equivSmallModel.{u}
          (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2.left)
    (q : X' ⟶ pullback f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))
    (hqt : q ≫ pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s) = f' ≫ t)
    (hq : q ≫ pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s) = g')
    (a : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F) ⟶
      (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)).smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).obj F))
    (ha : IsQcqsStrictLocalModuleComparison Λ f s F a) :
    let H := (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
      (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).obj F
    (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).sheafFiber.map
        ((baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).app F) =
      (upperStarCompSheafFiberIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) s
        (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).hom.app ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F) ≫
      eqToHom (by rw [Category.id_comp]) ≫
      a ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q H ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ _ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
        ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)) g' hq.symm).inv.app F) ≫
      (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').inv.app
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F) ≫
      (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _
        (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj
          (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ (Spec (.of Ω)))
          (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))) Over.mkIdTerminal)).hom.app
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').obj
              ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)) ≫
      (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω))))
        (Over.homMk (𝟙 _) (Category.comp_id _))
        ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)).obj

statement_change.what: Authorized retirement of the listed duplicate changes the formal realization from the small representative ring colimit to the adopted full affine-neighbourhood strictLocalization. These presentations are canonically isomorphic, not definitionally identical. The old ha was written out using unitSectionRestriction on the small limit leg; the adopted ha is IsQcqsStrictLocalModuleComparison on the full limit leg. Both original small-model consumer signatures and conclusions are preserved and proved directly from the general germ and unit restriction APIs in this packet. This changes the presentation, without weakening the geometric compatibility identity or editing any adopted source or target declaration.

old_proof.text: Cancel the inverse-image stalk isomorphism and use initiality of the small affine pointed representatives to apply colimit hom-ext. On each representative use exchange_pointed_representative. Apply unitSectionRestriction_comp to the small-model limit leg. Its composite with q has projections f′ followed by the marked point (hqt and hpoint), and g′ (hq), so pullback hom-ext identifies its graph with geometricFibreSectionLift. Expanding unitSectionRestriction yields the needed representative formula. Compose with the terminal evaluation factors and substitute ha; associativity gives the result.

Expand each former small-model qcqs restriction as unitSectionRestriction along the same small limit leg; expand the former comparison predicate as its germ equations. etaleSectionGraph is definitionally the former terminal graph. This changes only the spelling of the unit/restriction formulas and preserves every scheme, hypothesis, and conclusion.
